description.value: Pound Steak is a casual Japanese steakhouse in Richmond specializing in AAA Flat Iron Steak and handmade Hamburg Steak with Japanese-inspired sauces. The restaurant features a self-serve bar with unlimited Japanese-imported rice and miso soup with customizable toppings. Online ordering is available, and the dining experience blends authentic Japanese flavors with an approachable, casual atmosphere.
